correctness.rationale: For every monic squarefree septic f over algebraically closed characteristic-two field, y^3=f(x) has genus 6 by tame cyclic three-cover Riemann-Hurwitz; six forms dx/y,x dx/y, x^j dx/y^2 (j=0..3) form a basis at infinity. Applying Cartier with inverse Frobenius gives two off-diagonal blocks P (4x2) and Q (2x4). The columns of P are independent for squarefree f, since proportionality implies a repeated-square factor, so first Cartier rank four and a-number two. The 2x2 semilinear return H=QP has determinant sqrt(a2+a3 a6). When nonzero stable rank four; when zero rank-one twisting vanishes precisely if a3+a6^4=0, giving iterated profiles (4,3,2,2,...) versus (4,3,2,1,0,...), stable ranks two and zero. Parameter loci are graph hypersurface and codimension-two graph, smooth irreducible on squarefree open. Independent GF(2) exact-rank calculation of all squarefree monic septics found stable ranks 4:32,2:16,0:16, all matching formulas; the proof over all algebraically closed char-two fields is algebraic, not inferred from finite tests.
